dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Need a pillow? I can make one for you — I brought some cloth with me.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I also have a nice soft blanket here if you need a comforter.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Not interested? Well, I'm gonna take a nap anyway. Let me know when it's time to go.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I see a lot of people training in the art of the sword to pursue martial excellence. But that's not my goal.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I'm only interested in capturing the aesthetics of the sword, especially the interplay between light and shadow. Combat, for me, is a chance to get a wealth of inspiration in the bag.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: But don't worry. Even if I lose focus mid-battle, Tamoto will help you out.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I like the decor here. Seems like working in a different environment once in a while can be a good mood-booster.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Only thing is, once I get into work mode, I'm so focused on what I'm doing that I don't pay much attention to what's going on in the outside world.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: So if you need me for anything, you'll have get up close and personal to get my attention. Got it?
